core_principles: Fun over formal: Emphasize playful shapes, high-contrast colors, and chunky borders.
Neo-Brutalist contrast: Use heavy, solid drop shadows (offset without blur) and thick outlines to make elements pop off the screen like stickers.
Clear taxonomy: Color-code categories so the feed is instantly scannable.
Tactile interactions: Buttons should feel like physical, springy blocks.
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Playful, energetic, unstructured but legible, welcoming to all ages.

icons.usage: Use solid/chunky icons to match the bold font. E.g., Clock, Flame (for upvotes), ArrowDown, Image, Plus, Filter.

images.description: Abstract pattern with colorful organic shapes. Use this behind a container or hero section with a heavy black outline to frame it.
images.usage: Hero banner texture or call-to-action background in the app.

images.description: Colorful geometric pattern. Perfect for the split-screen login/register page as a purely decorative half-page background.
Group of differently colored shapes. Use as fallback avatar for users.

home_feed.layout: Bento-style grid for ideas. Include a sticky filter bar at the top.
home_feed.sorting: Toggle between 'Most Upvoted' and 'Newest First'. Design the toggle as a chunky pill switcher.
home_feed.idea_cards: Display title prominently in H3. Render category badge (using dynamic color map) and time badge. Image should be object-cover, bounded by a 2px black bottom border if placed at the top of the card.
home_feed.upvote_mechanic: A prominent section on the card (left side or bottom right) with up and down arrows. Active states should fill with a solid bright color (Red for down, Blue for up).

submit_idea_modal.layout: A heavy, thick-bordered dialog centered on screen with a dark backdrop (backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/40).
submit_idea_modal.fields: Title (large input), Description (textarea), Category (Select dropdown with colorful options), Time Needed (Radio group styled as clickable pills), Image URL (optional).
submit_idea_modal.action: A massive primary CTA button to submit.

login_register.layout: Split screen or centered massive card. Use the 'auth_background' image from the media section to make it feel vibrant.

user_profile.layout: Header with user stats (Total Ideas submitted, Total Upvotes received) styled in neo-brutalist blocks. Followed by a feed of their own ideas.
user_profile.actions: Idea cards here should include 'Edit' and 'Delete' buttons prominently. Delete button should be a bold red square icon button.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure black text (#0A0A0A) is used over all vibrant category colors for maximum readability.
accessibility_and_testing.focus_states: All inputs and buttons must have a heavy focus ring, e.g., 'focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#FACC15] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#FFFDF7]'.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: Mandatory 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles, cards).
